content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from todayyearsoldSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutedtodayyearsoldVerified•Followsho•noirMore optionstodayyearsoldVerified 4dThe tallest player in college basketball history 🤯A moment from Florida’s NCAA Tournament rout went viral when 6’8” Prairie View A&M player Hassane Diallo faced off against 7’9” Olivier Rioux. Cameras caught Diallo looking up in awe, asking “You a freshman?” before Rioux confirmed he was and Diallo responded “You BIG boy!” followed by an awkward silence and “Where you from?” ￼ Rioux is the tallest player in college basketball history and a Guinness World Record holder for world’s tallest teenager when he hit 7-foot-5 at age 16. ￼Rioux checked into the game with 1:54 left to go and the crowd went absolutely bananas, chanting “We want Ollie!” before he finally entered. ￼ He delivered a putback dunk and his teammates lost their minds, sprinting off the bench to celebrate with him.
